name: Conley Bottom Resort
note: Campground at the Conley Bottom marina resort on Lake Cumberland near Monticello: overnight sites with water, 30/50-amp electric and cable, plus permanent RV sites; dump station, bathhouses, laundry, swim area, restaurant and marina next door. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude

note: Small family campground at 7364 KY-815 south of Owensboro, beside a creek bend: RV sites with water and electric at $41 a night (2 adults + 2 children), weekly and monthly rates too; also rental campers and a cabin. RV Life 5*/$$. --Claude

name: Noble Pine Campground
note: Small farm campground at 510 Ollie Rd, a few hundred feet from Mammoth Cave National Park's Lincoln trailhead: about 10 pull-through and back-in sites with water and 30-amp electric at $40 a night (2026), covered horse stalls $5, plus cabins and glamping tents. Book by call or text. --Claude
